port_nicolo.line: A {piece}! Square, sensible, properly accounted for. I approve, Geometra.
port_nicolo.gossip: Overheard at the bank: Nicolò likes tables, enamel signs and signposts outside the bank, in sober slate grey.

port_gerolamo.line: A {piece}. A light and a rail: everything a sailor needs. Bless you.
port_gerolamo.gossip: Overheard on the breakwater: Gerolamo loves lamps, rail lanterns, railings and streetlights out along it, in lighthouse white.

port_lorenzo.line: A {piece}. I looked for something to complain about. I'm still looking.
port_lorenzo.gossip: Overheard at the harbour office: the Comandante likes stone blocks, columns, pillars and railings by the breakwater's root, in navy.

port_rosetta.line: Oh, a {piece}, right by my door! The dockers will love it. The gulls too, sadly.
port_rosetta.gossip: Overheard at the bakery: Rosetta wants tables, benches and flower beds outside her door, in the bakery's warm yellow.

port_giobatta.line: A {piece}! That's worth a thousand lire. Two. Don't tell anyone I said two.
port_giobatta.gossip: Overheard at the fish market: Baciccia likes counters, enamel signs and signposts round his stall, in sea green.

port_pina.line: Something green! A {piece}. Now put basil in it.
port_pina.gossip: Overheard from a balcony: Nonna Pina wants flower beds, hedges and trees by the arcades, in any green at all.

port_agostino.line: A {piece}, up by the lift. Thirty years I've wanted one of those here.
port_agostino.gossip: Overheard on the bastion: Agostino likes benches and lamps by the top stop, in a good honest brown.

port_stefano.line: A {piece} out on the water. Now that's seamanship.
port_stefano.gossip: Overheard on the quay: Stefano likes railings, rail lanterns and pontoons out on the breakwater, in oilskin yellow.

port_davide.line: Sick, a {piece}! Can I lean the scooter on it? I'm leaning the scooter on it.
port_davide.gossip: Overheard by the chandlery: Davide likes signposts and streetlights under the arcade, in scooter blue.
